current_decision: Keep Mini ARK as the active implementation name and Journey as the product identity until a deliberate migration is approved.

expression_rule.identity_boundary: Journey is the orchestration layer. External projects own their expression profiles.
expression_rule.stability_requirement: Profiles must preserve familiar controls, capability meaning, authority state, evidence and rollback semantics.

architecture_summary: Journey is the adaptive local orchestration layer that reconciles HEXSEED with the user's evolving way of working. Mini ARK is the current implementation name.
